 Dallas and Brooklyn meet for cross-conference contest 
 Dallas and Brooklyn face off in non-conference action 
 2:05 By The Associated Press November 8, 2026, 2:02 AM Share Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 13th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 10th in the Western Conference)
 Dallas; Sunday, 7:30 p.m. EST
 LINE: Mavericks -8.5; over/under is 219.5
 BOTTOM LINE: Dallas faces Brooklyn in out-of-conference action.
 Dallas finished 26-56 overall last season while going 16-25 at home. The Mavericks gave up 119.6 points per game while committing 18.4 fouls last season.
 Brooklyn went 20-62 overall, 14-37 in Eastern Conference games and 8-33 on the road last season. The Nets averaged 105.9 points per game last season, 17.9 on free throws and 39.3 from beyond the arc.
